title: Adequacy of Haemodiafiltration: Middle Molecules Clearance, Patients Reported Outcomes and Sodium Balance
official: Adequacy of Haemodiafiltration: Middle Molecules Clearance, Patients Reported Outcomes and Sodium Balance
summary: The goal of this observational study is to understand the differences in terms of middle molecules clearance and patient outcomes in High (\>23Litres (L)) vs Low (\<23 L) convection volume (CV) Hemodiafiltration (HDF) and to understand the effect of dialysate fluid sodium concentration (137 vs 140 mmol/L) on overhydration volume in patients on HD and HDF.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or above.
* Ability to give informed consent.
* End stage kidney disease (ESKD) treated by haemodialysis for at least 3 months.
* Prognosis \> 6 months as assessed by principal investigator (PI)
